title: DemiEngine Terrain Palette
description: Reusable map from semantic terrain roles to existing material, mesh and prefab assets. Authored as a DataAsset document with settings.content_type terrain_palette. Role vocabulary, scale ordering, collision policies and cross-asset resolution are additionally enforced by the C++ loader, because the engine's DataSchema validator ignores additionalProperties, minItems, maxItems, maxLength, pattern and uniqueItems.

roles.description: Keyed by role name rather than a list, so a duplicate role is structurally impossible and iteration order is deterministic.

required_roles.description: Roles a consumer must find. Every listed role must also exist in roles.

asset.description: Material, mesh or texture asset used for this role. Must resolve and be declared in the manifest dependencies.

prefab.description: Optional prefab spawned instead of the bare asset.

weight.description: Relative selection weight. At least one role must have a weight above 0.

scale.description: Physical scale range as [scale_min, scale_max] with scale_min <= scale_max.

spacing.description: World units between instances; 0 leaves placement unconstrained.
